POSITION OVERVIEW: As a Business Development Account Manager, you will work as the account manager for target customers to lead innovative programs and applications in additive manufacturing from early concept to full-scale production.

You will work closely with manufacturing and engineering teams at target accounts to be their dedicated Velo technical engineer and resource.

You will also work with Velo Applications Engineering and Field Management on difficult part production challenges and execution logistics to expedite the target account’s production adoption of Velo3D ’s end-to-end solution manufacturing process.

NEAR-TERM DELIVERABLES – First Year Demonstrate the ability to manage and guide the target account through a noticeable increase in demand generated on Sapphire systems.

Demonstrate the ability for the target account to view you as their go-to Velo technical engineer for current and future programs and applications Essential Functions Work in a fast-paced, growing company to lead target accounts into manufacturing production using Velo3D ’s end-to-end manufacturing solution.

Take ownership of target accounts through education and project/program management of all aspects for critical programs and applications from the early design phase and then from the prototype phase into full-scale production.

Ability to leverage previous experiences in design and manufacturing engineering to help target accounts visualize a manufacturing path forward to the final desired production manufacturing plan.

Design, modify, and analyze complex geometries in CAD and use Velo’s print preparation software to obtain estimated print times and costing quotes to present to target accounts.

Advanced problem solving and conflict resolution of complex and multi-entity situations, including but not limited to internal engineering teams, external engineering/manufacturing teams, and external customers/Contract Manufacturers (CMs) operating a Velo Sapphire.

Ability to document statement of work and customer acceptance criteria to communicate externally and internally Educate customers on known Velo3D part design allowables, including understanding physical and economic implications that could present themselves with printing vs. incumbent mfg. process.

Consult customers on potential design optimization and challenges for desired part geometries and effectively communicate this both visually and verbally. Work with Applications Engineering on parts and applications that are not part of the current design allowables by effectively communicating the problem statement.

Work closely and effectively with teams across multiple departments on technical projects. Maintain strong organizational skills concerning documentation, software analysis, and project management. NetBox Labs is seeking a Technology Alliances Manager to own and scale our strategic technology ecosystem. This is a senior individual contributor role with direct business impact and high executive visibility.

You will be the primary relationship owner and joint go-to-market driver for our most strategic technology partners — Red Hat Ansible, Nvidia, Cisco, HPE, Arista Networks, and Itential — with one clear mandate: open doors, drive business, and convert these relationships into revenue-producing routes to market for NetBox Labs, up to and including placement on our partners’ global price lists.
Four of our five priority partners are among the largest technology companies in the world, where executive access is earned, not given.

We’re looking for a sophisticated, alliance professional with relentless energy, initiative, and creativity — someone who builds their own momentum, navigates complex global organizations to reach the executives who matter, and is equally comfortable and productive with a senior leader in São Paulo, Bangalore, or Munich: a true citizen of the world.

Reporting to the Vice President of Global Partnerships, you will work closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing — and you will define the objectives and metrics by which NetBox Labs’ executive leadership tracks the alliance program’s progress.

Alliance Strategy & Executive Access
Own the global technology alliance strategy across Red Hat Ansible, Nvidia, Cisco, HPE, Arista Networks, and Itential, ensuring the portfolio aligns with NetBox Labs’ product vision, platform priorities, and go-to-market objectives.
Map the organization, build champions at every level, and convert them into VP- and C-suite sponsorship — these doors do not open by themselves.
Run two motions in parallel: land fast, visible wins with nimble partners like Itential while executing the longer, more complex campaigns required to break through at Cisco, HPE, Arista, and Red Hat.
Define partner tiering, engagement models, and investment levels across the technology alliance portfolio, and identify emerging partnership opportunities in adjacent ecosystems.
Routes to Market & Joint Go-to-Market Execution
Drive NetBox Labs onto partner global price lists and into resale, OEM, and marketplace programs that connect our products to partner sales organizations worldwide.
Design and launch joint GTM programs — co-sell motions, joint solution packaging, co-marketing campaigns, and field enablement — with success measured in programs launched and partner-influenced pipeline.
Build multi-year joint business plans and lead complex commercial engagements, including contract negotiations, pricing strategy, and incentive structures.
Partner with Sales team on account planning, opportunity identification, and co-selling with partner field organizations, and partner with Marketing on co-branded content, joint events, and demand campaigns.
Product & Integration Alignment
Serve as the voice of the partner in internal product planning, ensuring partner integration requirements and joint roadmap opportunities are reflected in NetBox Labs’ priorities.
Work with Engineering and Product to scope and deliver certified integrations and joint solutions that create tangible customer value.
Maintain command of partner platform roadmaps, capabilities, and certification programs, and position NetBox Labs strategically within them.
Executive Metrics & Alliance Governance
Define the objectives, KPIs, and scorecards for the technology alliance program — and build the reporting rhythm that enables NetBox Labs’ executive leadership to track and monitor progress with clarity and confidence.
Establish governance frameworks for each alliance: executive business reviews, partner lifecycle management, performance tracking, and long-range strategic planning sessions.
Report data-driven results to leadership: programs launched, integration adoption, partner-influenced pipeline, and route-to-market milestones such as price-list placement and partner-status achievements.
Cross-Functional & Global Representation
Operate as the internal champion for technology alliances, building simple, repeatable playbooks that help internal teams and partner stakeholders co-sell and co-market effectively.
Represent NetBox Labs at partner summits, industry forums, and ecosystem events worldwide, engaging partner executives across regions, cultures, and time zones.

5-7+ years of experience in technology alliances, business development, or strategic partnerships within enterprise software, SaaS, or infrastructure technology — including direct experience with one or more priority partners (Cisco, Red Hat Ansible, Nvidia, HPE, Arista Networks, or similar network infrastructure and automation vendors).
A track record of earning executive sponsorship inside matrixed global organizations and converting it into commercial outcomes — global price list placement, resale or OEM agreements, marketplace listings, or equivalent routes to market.
Self-generated energy, initiative, and creativity: you build your own momentum, hunt for opportunity, and never sit back waiting for the business to come to you.
Demonstrated ability to define alliance objectives, metrics, and scorecards, and to communicate progress to executive leadership in clear, data-driven terms.
Deep domain expertise in network automation, network infrastructure, or IT operations technology — credible with both technical and business audiences at partner organizations.
Demonstrated executive presence and global refinement: culturally fluent, polished, and effective when engaging with senior executives throughout the Americas, APAC, and EMEA.
Proven ability to align stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing without direct authority.
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field; an advanced degree is a plus.

Experience with open source ecosystems or community-driven platform businesses; familiarity with network source of truth, IPAM, DCIM, or automation tooling such as Ansible, Nornir, or Terraform.
Background in product management, solutions engineering, or technical pre-sales — fluency in integration architecture discussions.
A successful record in large, complex deal negotiations; experience with hyperscaler marketplaces, global price lists, or channel/alliance programs at major technology vendors.
Understanding of agentic AI, MCP (Model Context Protocol), or API-first platform architectures and how they are reshaping enterprise infrastructure management.
International experience — living, working, or managing alliances across regions; additional languages are a plus.

NetBox Labs helps companies build and manage complex networks. We help customers accelerate network automation by delivering open, composable products and supporting the network automation community.
NetBox Labs is the commercial steward of open source NetBox, the world’s most popular network source of truth, and Orb, the next-generation open source network observability platform. Our products include NetBox Enterprise, a fully supported self-managed NetBox with advanced features, and NetBox Cloud, a secure, scalable, and reliable SaaS edition of NetBox.

Meet DeepL
DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.
Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.
What sets us apart
What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.
When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.
What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL on LinkedIn , Instagram , and our Blog .

s.h: Meet the team behind this journey
s.t:
At DeepL, we're on an exciting adventure to expand our operations to match our ambitious growth plans. At the heart of this journey is our Marketing team, a cornerstone of DeepL's strategic outreach and brand-building efforts.
Our mission is clear: to build and develop high-performing marketing teams that embody DeepL's innovative spirit and drive for excellence. As a member of our Marketing team, you will be at the forefront of crafting and sharing the DeepL story with the world. Working in close partnership with Product, Sales, and Customer Success teams, you will collaborate to create compelling campaigns and strategies that resonate with our diverse global audience.

Proactively engage prospects via phone, email, and social channels to generate qualified meetings for the sales team
Manage a high volume of outbound conversations, balancing speed with a personalised approach
Work closely with AI-powered tools and automation to streamline outreach and focus your time on high-value conversations
Partner closely with the wider DACH and AMIA sales teams to align on target accounts and messaging
Consistently hit activity and meeting-booked targets in a fast-paced, target-driven environment
Represent DeepL professionally and enthusiastically in every interaction, as often the first point of contact prospects have with the company
Qualities we look for
Fluent in Italian and English
High energy, proactive, and comfortable picking up the phone and having lots of conversations day-to-day
A "hit the ground running" attitude — you don't need direct SDR experience, but you do need drive, resilience, and a positive, can-do mindset
Comfortable with change and ambiguity — we're a fast-moving company and things evolve quickly
Genuine curiosity about AI and how it's transforming sales development, rather than viewing it as a threat
Team player who thrives working closely with colleagues across sales, in a collaborative, in-office culture (2–3 days/week in London)

Diverse and internationally distributed team : joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.
Open communication, regular feedback : as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.
Hybrid work, flexible hours : we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.
Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.
Regular in-person team events : we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.
Monthly full-day hacking sessions : every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.
30 days of annual leave : we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.
Competitive benefits : just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.
If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

We are an equal opportunity employer
You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. The Opportunity

Work closely with tech, product, retail, and finance teams to ensure smooth integration, ramp-up, and ongoing operations of the airport transfer segment
Create feedback loops between market activity and product , surfacing what works, what doesn't, and what needs to change
Workplace: This role is remote, in Europe, reporting into our commercial team and working with global stakeholders across multiple countries.

InStride Health ’s mission is to deliver specialty anxiety and OCD care that works for every kid, teen, young adult, and family who needs it. Through this mission, we are expanding access to insurance-based care, increasing engagement in treatment, and improving treatment outcomes.

We are doing this by combining research-backed clinical care and innovative technology to eliminate the major problems with care today: difficulty finding providers, months of waiting to be seen, arduous onboarding processes, and inconsistent use of evidence-based therapies and outcomes tracking.

Our vision is to become the nation’s most trusted provider of pediatric anxiety and OCD care.
Team InStride Health : Our Core Values

Give Heart : We lead with heart, treating patients and their families the way we want our loved ones to be treated.

Work Smart : We find smarter ways to solve hard problems and fix the broken mental health system by leveraging technology, diversity of thought, and innovation.

Have Humility : We leave our egos at the door, empowering our team to collaborate, celebrate diversity, and adopt a growth mindset.

Embrace Community: We all belong. We are in this together, and we never worry alone. We believe in each other and recognize that every voice matters.

About the Role We are looking for a Vice President of Business Development to lead InStride Health ’s national field sales organization and set our strategy for building trusted referral partnerships with pediatricians, child psychiatrists, and health systems.

Reporting directly to the Chief Commercial Officer and sitting on the Commercial Leadership Team, you will own a layered field organization of Regional Directors and Territory Managers, turning local provider trust into a scalable, national referral engine for pediatric anxiety and OCD care.

This is a high-impact executive role for a leader who wants to build a category-defining go-to-market motion at a fast-growing, mission-driven company, and we have a strong preference for candidates based in the Eastern time zone given the amount of field travel this role requires. This is a fully remote position.

Key Responsibilities Field Sales Strategy & Technology
Design and scale InStride’s national field coverage model using regional referral data, capacity modeling, and growth targets.
Evaluate and adopt sales technology, including AI-enabled tools, to improve lead qualification, pipeline visibility, and territory coverage.
Build field metrics and pipeline reporting that tracks referrals from first provider contact through enrollment.
Track health system and market trends to inform territory planning ahead of geographic expansion.
Commercial & Cross-Functional Leadership
Serve as an active member of the Commercial Leadership Team, partnering with the CCO, VP of Marketing, and SVP of Payor Growth to build unified go-to-market strategy.
Set service-level agreements with Clinical Admissions leadership that remove intake bottlenecks and strengthen the onboarding experience.
Translate field insights from providers and health systems into recommendations for clinical delivery and product leadership.
Protect InStride’s reputation with providers and families, ensuring growth targets never come at the expense of a compassionate experience.
Team Leadership & Organizational Design
Coach and develop a team of Regional Directors, who manage a national team of Territory Managers.
Build an accountable, results-driven field culture that stays true to InStride’s mission and values.
Own sales enablement, onboarding, and performance management for the field organization.
Guide Regional Directors through complex personnel decisions, territory design, and performance management cases.
Provider Partnership Strategy & Key Accounts
Define InStride’s approach to building consultative, trust-based partnerships with pediatricians, child psychiatrists, and health systems.
Personally manage InStride’s most significant provider relationships and lead strategic conversations with health system leadership.
Travel 15-25% of the time to lead field rides, evaluate team performance, and close key partnerships.
Turn successful local sales approaches into playbooks the broader field team can use nationally.

s.h: What You Need to Succeed in the Role
s.t:
10+ years of progressive commercial leadership experience in healthcare business development, provider sales, or healthcare services, including 4+ years managing people managers within a field sales organization.
Experience operating within a venture-backed or private equity-backed, high-growth healthcare startup environment and building or scaling a field sales organization from an early stage.
Direct experience in pediatric healthcare, behavioral health, or youth mental health, with a clear understanding of the clinical trust required to work with pediatricians, child psychiatrists, and health systems.
Strong track record of using CRM and modern sales technology stacks, including proven experience or a clear vision for leveraging AI-based tools to automate, optimize, and enhance field sales team performance.
Experience reporting directly to C-suite leadership and contributing to a cross-functional commercial leadership team.
Experience managing high-stakes provider relationships, and ideally partnering closely with a payor-facing counterpart.
An established network of relationships with pediatric health systems, provider groups, or behavioral health referral sources.

Providing high quality patient care to families. We are in a privileged position to support families during a vulnerable time in their lives. We approach all families and each other with compassion and are most effective as a diverse team where all individuals feel valued, respected, and accepted.

About Passionfroot
Creator-led growth is one of the fastest-growing channels in B2B - we're building the infrastructure behind it.
Passionfroot is the leading platform where modern companies scale creator-led growth, and where top creators manage and monetize brand partnerships.
Our customers are some of the most ambitious, fastest-moving companies in the world - Replit, Figma, Framer, LumaAI, Gamma, Airtable - companies that set the standard for what modern growth looks like. We help them run high-impact creator programs across LinkedIn, YouTube, newsletters, and more.
We're growing 13x in revenue year over year, profitable, and just closed our Series A round! We are backed by leading investors including Insight Partners , Creandum , Supernode and founders and operators from Cursor, Anthropic, n8n and more. We're expanding fast across New York, Europe, and Brazil - and we're just getting started.

Passionfroot exists to empower creators to go after their passion - to turn what they love into a real business.
Today, we work with thousands of creators: LinkedIn thought leaders, YouTube educators, newsletter writers, podcast hosts, and a new generation of B2B creators who are reshaping how companies reach their audiences.

These aren't traditional influencers - they're founders, operators, AI researchers, engineers, marketers, and subject-matter experts who have built trusted audiences around real expertise.

Our creator community includes some of the most influential voices in business, technology, and education, including creators such as Elena Verna, Marina Mogilko, and Zain Kahn.
As our Creator Partnership Manager, your job is to find and onboard the best creators for the best B2B tech brands in the world. You'll build the sourcing pipeline, run a great onboarding experience, and turn what works into repeatable systems so we can keep scaling creator supply as the company grows.
You'll work closely with growth, ops, and the campaign team, with plenty of room to shape how this function runs day to day.

You'll build a strong sense for what makes a creator a fit for B2B tech brands, spot promising creators early, and develop relationships with creator communities and agencies to keep the pipeline full.
Onboard them brilliantly
Get creators from first contact to their first paid partnership as smoothly as possible. You'll design and run onboarding flows that remove friction, answer questions fast, and set creators up to succeed on the platform from day one.
Build scalable systems
Turn what works into process. You'll document sourcing and onboarding playbooks, build workflows and tools that let us onboard more creators without sacrificing quality, and continuously test and improve how we find and activate creators.

Source and vet creators across LinkedIn, YouTube, newsletters, and emerging platforms - with a focus on the best fits for B2B tech brands
Build relationships with creator communities and agencies to keep a strong pipeline flowing
Design and run onboarding flows that get creators to their first paid partnership quickly
Build the systems, docs, and workflows that let sourcing and onboarding scale without losing quality
Run experiments on sourcing channels and onboarding steps, and double down on what works
Work directly with brand and campaign teams to match the right creators to the right opportunities
Stay close to what creators need and feed that insight back into product and process

You are the first human a London landlord speaks to. We generate the demand — paid inbound, portal activity, lead ads pre-qualified by our own AI agent, cold email, leaflets, referrals — and you turn it into signed instructions.
Landlords rarely arrive asking for a named product; they arrive with a problem — an agent they've had enough of, a property they can't get to, a tenancy they don't want to run. Your first job is to work out which of our services solves it, and say so. Valuations, viewings, photography and key handovers sit with operations, so your day is conversations, offers and closes.
This is one role across four rungs, levelled on the scope you own rather than years served. At BDC you work the company lead feeds from the desk: qualify, put a number in front of the landlord, close instructions across the range. At Senior BDC you take the harder pipeline — portfolios, agent switches, the deals that need pricing judgement.

At BDM you own the close, the price and the commercials, with your own sourcing on top of the feeds. At Senior BDM you carry the largest number and own retention.
What you'll own
The first call. Every new lead lands as a task with your name on it. You call it the day it lands, and you get to the landlord's real constraint — money, distance or hassle — before you pitch anything.
The routing decision. DIY, Placed, Managed or Secured — you decide which tier fits the property and the landlord, and you answer for the ones routed wrong.
The number. A figure is the hook; a brochure isn't. You give the landlord what they'd achieve and what they'd take home on each route — and you answer the two objections that lose deals on the same call: price (net income across the whole term, not a headline rent) and trust ("is this rent-to-rent", "will I get my property back" — answered from the agreement).
Your pipeline, in the CRM. Outcome logged, lead status set, next step dated — before you finish the call. A lead with no next step is a lead we've lost.
The close and the price. First conversation → assessment → offer → signed agreement, without being chased through it, then the renter offers that decide what the property actually lets for. You recommend the figure and defend it, knowing the company lives with it for the full term.
The commercials, and your own sourcing. Fee, term and let price on a Managed instruction; the spread on a Secured one. You answer for what the deal earns, not just that it closed. Company feeds are a floor: portfolio landlords, agent switches and referrers you build yourself sit on top.
Senior BDM: retention. Re-signing a landlord is worth more than finding a new one. You own the renewal number and the save.
How we sell
We sell the outcome, not the product. Rent that arrives, a tenancy that runs itself, compliance that never lands on the landlord — then route to the tier that delivers it and price it properly.
We're honest — about the trade and about what we're on the hook for. Every tier asks something of the landlord and gives something back. No subletting, no company lets, no short lets; the landlord stays the landlord. Said plainly, that wins more than overselling — and filters out the price-shoppers who are our biggest single loss reason.
We price on evidence. Comparables, condition, void risk and the renter market decide the figure — not how badly you want the instruction — and nothing gets promised that the valuation won't support.
AI does the prep, you do the selling. Property and market research, call notes, follow-up drafts and pipeline hygiene are increasingly automated. We expect you to use that, not to type around it.

Experience.
BDC: ~1-2 years in a target-driven, phone-led sales role.
BDM / Senior BDM: ~2+ years closing your own deals — consistently at or above quota, with a number you can evidence.
Lettings or BTR instruction-winning strongly preferred; estate agency or another consultative, high-volume sales background considered.
Grit and a desire to win. You make the last call of the day sound like the first, and a bad week makes you dial more, not less.
You run your own pipeline properly — dated next steps, clean CRM, nothing dropped — and you can cold-call without warming up first.

German SMEs carry an unavoidable administrative load: bookkeeping, monthly VAT returns, annual accounts. Work that must happen, that nobody wants to do, and that has stayed far too expensive.
mika takes it over. Because compliance is mandatory rather than optional, what we are building is infrastructure, and the purpose is to reduce the cost of doing business in Germany.
We went from 100 to over 700 customers in eight months and remain a small team. Roles here are therefore wide: you own an area rather than a slice of one, there is more to build than there are people to build it, and your scope grows as you do. We work in English, the team is international, the market is German.
Tasks
Partner and referral leads arrive already trusting us, which is the hardest part of our sale to manufacture any other way. We have only recently started testing this properly and it is already carrying a meaningful share of new pipeline. The pieces exist and nobody holds them together.
Networker and closer, in one person. Partnerships attracts people who are wonderful in a room, know everybody, and never sign anything. It also attracts people who can close but cannot keep a relationship alive past the signature. We need both halves.
And we need somebody who knows that a partnership is more than paying someone to send us customers. The ones that last are built on something both sides actually want: a better answer for their own customers, a gap in their offering closed, a reason for them to look good. If your instinct is to open with a commission rate, this is not the role.
You build the channel across referral and integration partners and the programmes around them, and you shape where it goes beyond that. We will talk about the specifics in the process.

Own the channel and its number end to end
Close. Take partnerships from first conversation to signed agreement, including the commercial negotiation.
Structure the deals yourself. Work out what the partner gets, at which price tier, on the subscription or on the one-off revenue or both, over what period. You should know our unit economics well enough to say no without asking.
Own what happens after signature: technical handover, partner onboarding, and the routing rule agreed with the sales lead
Own the affiliate programme and our comparison-page strategy, working with our creative lead on production
Own our presence at events and conferences, where a surprising share of partnerships actually start
Prepare joint marketing with existing partners: webinars, co-branded content, campaigns
Apply our values filter honestly. Not every partner who would send us volume is one we want, and we would rather you turned one down than explained it afterwards.

s.h: what you bring to the table
s.t:
AI-native, not AI-curious. Claude or an equivalent is your daily sparring partner rather than a tool you open occasionally. You augment your own output with it and you automate the parts of your job that should not need a human.
You have closed partnership deals yourself , negotiated the terms, and can name what they produced afterwards
Ideally a real network in the German SME and entrepreneurship world, or in fintech.
You are commercially fluent. Revenue share, referral fees, attribution windows, exclusivity, minimum commitments: you model a deal and defend the structure.
You understand a business well enough to build the case from the partner's side rather than pitching at them
You follow up relentlessly and you keep partners warm after launch, which is where most partnerships quietly die
You are organised enough to run many parallel conversations without letting any of them go cold
the level we are hiring at
If you have been the second person in a function somewhere good and this is your step up, that is the profile we want. We have a strong bias towards people who have been entrepreneurs themselves. As the team grows, the path from here leads to Head of Partnerships.
We keep the team small by giving people leverage instead of headcount. That is why the AI point above is a requirement rather than a preference, and it is what lets one person hold more live conversations at once than this job would otherwise allow.

German fintech or banking ecosystem
Platform and marketplace partnerships
Comfortable in a technical scoping conversation, enough to know what is easy and what is not
Affiliate and influencer programmes
API integrations and partner onboarding flows
Event and conference experience
German at C1 or above is preferred. The ecosystem we are building in is German and so are most of the negotiations. For an exceptional candidate we would work with English alone, so if the rest fits, apply anyway. English at B2 or above in either case, since it is our working language.

Base 60,000 to 80,000 EUR depending on experience, plus a variable component tied to activated partners and partner-sourced revenue rather than to pipeline volume, plus stock options. On-target earnings 75,000 to 100,000 EUR.
Three rounds: an intro conversation, a working session with a short case, and a final round with the founders. why mika?

Deals you structure yourself , rather than terms handed to you
Founders in the detail with you , and no layer between you and a decision
A category nobody has built. German business owners do not know an alternative to their tax advisor exists, which is also why the right partner is worth so much to us.
Work that matters outside the building. Every customer a partner sends us gets back time and money that was disappearing into paperwork.
